image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a pile of assorted bagels. The bagels vary in toppings, including sesame seeds, poppy seeds, and coarse salt or garlic/onion flakes. They exhibit a golden-brown crust with a glossy sheen, characteristic of boiled-then-baked dough. The central holes are visible on most, though some are partially obscured by the stacking. The lighting is bright, highlighting the texture of the seeds and the crust.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Multiple bagels clearly display the toroidal shape with a distinct central hole. The ratio of hole diameter to overall diameter appears consistent with real bagels (narrower than donuts).

The objects match the visual definition of traditional bagels.
